Title: Azure Redis Cache: Preview of new administration options in Premium tier

Body.Content:
The Azure Redis Cache team is pleased to announce the preview of the following administration options:

  • Reboot. You can reboot one or more nodes of your cache on demand. This allows you to test your application for resiliency in the event of a failure. You can reboot the master (primary) node, slave (secondary) node, or both nodes together. For more information, see Reboot.
  • Schedule updates. You can designate a maintenance window for updates to the Redis server. For more information, see Schedule updates.
